components.name: Terminal shell
components.description: An isolated browser Bash surface on the homepage.
components.css: .ds-terminal{border:1px solid var(--var-color-border,#d8e0e7);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--var-color-background,#fff);color:var(--var-color-foreground,#171c27)}.ds-terminal-bar{border-bottom:1px solid var(--var-color-border,#d8e0e7);padding:12px;font:12px monospace}.ds-terminal pre{padding:16px;margin:0;font:13px/1.5 monospace}.ds-terminal:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--var-color-primary,#00A6F4)}

narrative.overview: A calm editorial surface: generous margin around real writing, quiet dividers instead of card chrome, and a small working terminal as an invitation to explore.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Do not add another brand hue to compete with the blue.

dos: Keep every route and long-form article readable without using the terminal.
Preserve keyboard focus and an Escape-then-Tab exit from the terminal.
donts: Turn writing lists into equal-sized promotional cards or use gradients as decoration.
